title: Learner Growth, Daily Preparation & Wellbeing Rhythm
description: Personal sanctuary for learners and individuals to plan tomorrow with three gentle things, manage daily study goals, track school timetable periods, and engage in mindful reflection.

intents.title: Prepare Tomorrow Rhythm & Study Priorities
intents.outcome: Capture three gentle prep goals and personal study tasks with fluid tactile interaction.

journeys.title: Manage Tomorrow's Preparation
journeys.situation: In the evening during the wind-down phase, a learner opens Self to set three intentional things to prepare for tomorrow.
journeys.outcome: Goals are captured in local SQLite and swiped complete the next day with tactile haptic feedback.

existingBehavior: TomorrowPrep component renders the Tomorrow Prep list powered by TodoView.
SwipeableTodoRow provides fluid RNGH 3.4 + Reanimated 4 gesture completion.
invariants: Daily prep must remain simple and non-coercive (encouraging 3 gentle things, avoiding overwhelming backlog pressure).
Tasks sync offline-first with zero lag.
openQuestions: How should unfinished prep items carry over to the next morning without guilt framing?

steps.title: Open Self Workspace
steps.interaction: Navigate to the Self tab during evening wind-down.

steps.title: Complete Prep Item
steps.interaction: Swipe right to mark item done.

transitions.title: Focus Prep Input
transitions.feedback: Show clean inline input dressed in active world theme.

transitions.title: Mark Done
transitions.feedback: Green reveal with light haptic tick, strikethrough, and smooth spring layout.

requirements.title: Sensory & Tactile Reinforcement
requirements.statement: Completing a prep item must provide immediate visual spring easing and haptic reinforcement.

bindings.title: Tomorrow Prep Component
bindings.note: Renders modern TodoView for Tomorrow Prep.

scenarios.title: Plan Tomorrow and Complete Next Day
scenarios.expected: Item is created in Tomorrow Prep list and swiped complete smoothly.

intents.title: Navigate Daily Timetable Periods
intents.outcome: View today's schedule, subjects, rooms, and upcoming class periods.

journeys.title: View Daily Class Timetable
journeys.situation: A student needs to know which subject, teacher, and room they should be in during the current period.
journeys.outcome: Current and upcoming class periods are displayed with active period highlighted.
preconditions: Authenticated account is enrolled in at least one active classroom.

existingBehavior: useTimetable loads period schedules with offline cache fallback.
invariants: Timetable periods are cached locally so students in remote classrooms can view their schedule offline.
openQuestions: How should room swaps or substitute teacher notices be indicated dynamically on the period card?

steps.title: View Timetable Periods
steps.interaction: Inspect morning and afternoon period cards.

transitions.title: Inspect Periods
transitions.feedback: Filter and display periods for the selected day.

requirements.title: Offline Schedule Availability
requirements.statement: Class period schedules must be readable even when the device is completely disconnected.

scenarios.title: Check Daily Periods
scenarios.expected: Daily periods are rendered with subject names and room numbers.

intents.title: Engage in Mindful Breathing & Emotional Attunement
intents.outcome: Reset nervous system through guided breathing and record feelings.

journeys.title: Mindful Breathing Reset
journeys.situation: A learner feeling agitated or overwhelmed seeks a quick calming reset.
journeys.outcome: Gentle breath cadence is delivered with sensory haptics and peaceful visuals.
preconditions: App is running in any context.

existingBehavior: BreathGuide component renders expanding/contracting lotus visual.
invariants: Mindful breathing can be cancelled at any second without judgment or penalties.
openQuestions: Should audio bells or binaural audio support be bundled or downloaded on demand?

steps.title: Begin Breathing Exercise
steps.interaction: Tap Lotus breathing button from header or FAB.

transitions.title: Settle into Calm
transitions.action: Complete at least one breath cycle
transitions.feedback: Gentle haptic pulse at turnaround points.

requirements.title: Unforced Calming Motion
requirements.statement: Breathing animation curves must follow sinusoidal natural easing without sudden velocity breaks.

scenarios.title: Calming Reset Session
scenarios.expected: Breathing visual expands and contracts with soothing haptics.
